title: Prioritizing MMP8 as an exploratory therapeutic candidate in Parkinson's disease through proteome-wide Mendelian randomization and computational multi-omics integration.
snippet: Parkinson's disease (PD) lacks disease-modifying therapies. We aimed to prioritize circulating proteins using multi-omics integration combining proteome-wide Mendelian randomization (MR) for discovery with network, structural, and single-cell evidence for prioritization. title: Pathophysiology and Pharmacological Management of Chronic Liver Injury: Current Challenges and Future Directions.
